c2_bad.why: Unchanged from c1 and still holding the second CORE slot on lexical 0.19: patient banner, master-detail, large numerics with units, interruption-safe autosave and destructive confirmation have nothing to do with an empty result state on a list page. comp-empty-state - the one component record that is literally the subject of the sentence - is still not selected.

New in c2 and it displaced a11y-focus-visible, which c1's implementation actually verified against (2px teal ring on the new Clear search button). Bypass blocks and landmark shortcuts are a shell concern; the task adds one button and one live region inside an existing Card. It is also a worse carrier for interaction.focus_restore, which the fix depends on (Clear search must return focus to the search field).

c2_direction_unjustified.why: 'sharp' directly contradicts the codebase: ClinicBoard's README and tailwind.config.ts set a 6px default radius with rounded-sm at 4px, and every card/badge/control uses it. Inspect still reports radius=UNKNOWN, so the value is asserted without evidence.

why: The guidance bundle is materially the same as c1 (one guardrail swapped, and comp-search no longer tags the forbidden media.search_tv), but the direction is transformed: the six slots that c1 emitted and the implementer had to ignore - layout-master-detail, surface-elevated-cards, card-poster-landscape, cta-sticky-bar, imagery-poster, icon-text-only, plus the density change - are now null, surfaces is correctly detected as bordered-flat, and validation passes.
